```{r}
test_wiener_decorr <- function(data,
                               test_normalite = "shapiro",
                               alpha = 0.05) {
  # Vérification des données
  if (!all(c("t", "x") %in% names(data))) {
    stop("data doit contenir les colonnes 't' et 'x'")
  }
  t <- data$t
  x <- data$x
  if (length(t) != length(x)) stop("t et x doivent avoir la même longueur")
  if (any(diff(t) <= 0)) stop("Les temps doivent être strictement croissants")
  
  n <- length(t) - 1
  if (n < 2) stop("Il faut au moins 3 observations (n >= 2)")
  
  dt <- diff(t)
  dx <- diff(x)
  
  # Calcul des D_i (avec Y0 = 0)
  Y <- dx / dt
  Y0 <- 0
  D <- Y - c(Y0, Y[1:(n-1)])
  
  # Construction de la matrice M
  M <- matrix(0, n, n)
  M[1,1] <- 1 / dt[1]
  if (n > 1) M[1,2] <- -1 / dt[1]
  if (n > 2) {
    for (i in 2:(n-1)) {
      M[i, i-1] <- -1 / dt[i-1]
      M[i, i]   <- 1/dt[i-1] + 1/dt[i]
      M[i, i+1] <- -1 / dt[i]
    }
  }
  if (n > 1) {
    M[n, n-1] <- -1 / dt[n-1]
    M[n, n]   <- 1/dt[n-1] + 1/dt[n]
  }
  
  # M^{-1/2} via expm
  if (!requireNamespace("expm", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("expm")
  }
  library(expm, quietly = TRUE)
  M_inv_sqrt <- sqrtm(solve(M))
  
  # Décorrélation : Z = M^{-1/2} D
  Z <- as.vector(M_inv_sqrt %*% D)
  
  # Test de normalité sur Z (noms des tests en minuscules)
  test_norm_lower <- tolower(test_normalite)
  p_norm <- switch(test_norm_lower,
    shapiro = shapiro.test(Z)$p.value,
    anderson = nortest::ad.test(Z)$p.value,
    cvm = nortest::cvm.test(Z)$p.value,
    lilliefors = nortest::lillie.test(Z)$p.value,
    jarque = tseries::jarque.bera.test(Z)$p.value,
    agostino = fBasics::dagoTest(Z)@test$p.value[3],
    stop("Test inconnu. Choix: shapiro, anderson, cvm, lilliefors, jarque, agostino")
  )
  
  alpha_N <- alpha / 2
  if (p_norm < alpha_N) {
    return(list(
      rejet_H0 = TRUE,
      test = "N",
      p_value_norm = p_norm,
      p_value_mu = NA
    ))
  }
  
  # Test de Student sur la moyenne de Z
  p_mu <- t.test(Z, mu = 0)$p.value
  alpha_M <- alpha / 2
  rejet_M <- p_mu < alpha_M
  
  return(list(
    rejet_H0 = rejet_M,
    test = ifelse(rejet_M, "M", "Aucun"),
    p_value_norm = p_norm,
    p_value_mu = p_mu
  ))
}
```

# Exemple d'application

                      x = c(0, 0.3, 0.8, 1.1, 1.7, 9.0))

# Appel de la fonction 
res <- test_wiener_decorr(data_ex, test_normalite = "Shapiro", alpha = 0.05)

res

```{r}
sim_hwp <- function(t_obs, mu, sigma) {
  dt <- diff(t_obs)
  dx <- mu * dt + sigma * sqrt(dt) * rnorm(length(dt))
  x <- c(0, cumsum(dx))
  return(data.frame(t = t_obs, x = x))
}

sim_nhwp <- function(t_obs, sigma_true, mu = 1) {
  dt <- diff(t_obs)
  dX <- mu * diff(t_obs^2) + sigma_true * sqrt(dt) * rnorm(length(dt))
  x <- c(0, cumsum(dX))
  return(data.frame(t = t_obs, x = x))
}
```


```{r}
MC_wiener <- function(N = N, scenario, t_obs, 
                      mu = NULL, sigma = NULL, sigma_true = NULL, 
                      alpha = 0.05) {
  tests <- c("shapiro", "jarque", "lilliefors", "anderson", "cvm", "agostino")
  
  une_iter <- function() {
    if (!is.null(mu) && !is.null(sigma)) {
      X <- scenario(t_obs = t_obs, mu = mu, sigma = sigma)
    } else if (!is.null(sigma_true)) {
      X <- scenario(t_obs = t_obs, sigma_true = sigma_true)
    } else {
      stop("Spécifiez soit (mu, sigma), soit sigma_true.")
    }
    X <- as.data.frame(X)
    names(X) <- c("t", "x")
    
    res <- vapply(tests, function(test_norm) {
      as.integer(test_wiener_decorr(data = X, test_normalite = test_norm, alpha = alpha)$rejet_H0)
    }, integer(1))
    return(res)
  }
  
  res_mat <- replicate(N, une_iter())
  taux_rejet <- rowMeans(res_mat)
  names(taux_rejet) <- c("Shapiro", "JarqueBera", "Lilliefors", "Anderson", "Cramer", "Agostino")
  return(taux_rejet)
}

```

```{r}
N = 1000
 
```

# Niveau

```{r}
n = 100
t_obs_reg <- seq(0, 1, length.out = n+1)
set.seed(46)
niveau <- MC_wiener(N = N, scenario = sim_hwp, t_obs = t_obs_reg,
                    mu = 0, sigma = 1, alpha = alpha)
cat("Niveau (taux de rejet sous H0) :\n")
print(niveau)
```

# Puissance

```{r}
set.seed(46)
puissance <- MC_wiener(N = Nsim, scenario = sim_nhwp, t_obs = t_obs_reg, sigma_true = 1, alpha = alpha)
print(puissance)
```
